claims.statement: persistent agents retain identity and lineage across model or provider replacement
persistent agents execute versioned operational graphs around bounded inference points
goal resolution selects, adapts, composes, creates, or bounds a process from goal and context
learning converts repeated successful inference into evaluated lower-inference behavior
superseded prompt instructions retire when deterministic mechanisms replace them
preferences resolve deterministically by authority and scope and react to explicit correction and drift
durable memory is typed and selectively retrieved without unbounded prompt growth
agent generations are immutable append-only lineage with runtime-derived introspection and rollback
canonical local state exports, imports, and reconciles across machines without last-writer-wins loss
behavioral change uses a separate candidate generation, independent evaluation, governed promotion, and rollback
catalog packages bootstrap reusable behavior without importing private personalized state
preference contracts seed only material choices and migrate without silent reinterpretation
reasoning tiers and executor selection remain model-independent and observable
routing uses demonstrated capability evidence without overriding eligibility or authority
cross-agent learning transfers generalized scoped artifacts rather than raw episodic memory
longitudinal evaluation detects regressions, repeated inference, variance, and model-portability failures
contradictory evidence can fork or demote deterministic behavior back toward inference
core execution, authority, evidence, and learning remain domain-neutral while overlays extend domain semantics
distributed packages have immutable provenance, signatures, capability review, and explicit trust decisions
behavioral profiles distinguish declared, inherited, observed, measured, and confirmed evidence
the Go core supervises language-neutral out-of-process plugins with negotiated lifecycle, streaming, cancellation, and recovery
canonical versioned contracts preserve stable identity, scope inheritance, compatibility, and migrations
authoritative events and projections support replay, checkpoint recovery, and causal observability after restart
slice scheduling uses ordered leases with bounded starvation, cancellation release, and recovery semantics
every mutation and external effect traverses one command boundary with durable idempotent outcomes
client-neutral invocation contracts execute consistently across adapters and unavailable optional affordances degrade safely
authoritative actions are enforced deterministically below the LLM and fail closed when required mediation is absent
workspace intelligence incrementally indexes authoritative sources and emits bounded fresh evidence context
untrusted content can influence proposals but cannot authorize actions or silently become authoritative memory
plugin capability denial is backed by effective process, filesystem, network, credential, and resource isolation
approval binds canonical action intent and is atomically revalidated and consumed at the side-effect commit boundary
cryptographic profiles perform agile PQ-preferred signing and key establishment without silent downgrade and preserve rotation
planning rigor is progressive and reusable baselines drive dependency-aware delta planning
the domain-neutral Goals graph interactively compiles original intent, uncertainty, decisions, models, specifications, and plans into a reusable baseline
installed packages atomically add and remove validated client-visible commands without rebuilding the core
runtime services use semantic authoritative-state provider contracts and fail closed on provider capability mismatch
pure graph, agent, and mixed packages install, activate, update, and roll back as universal distribution units
domain-configured resource pressure can govern durable graph handoff and resume while preserving run, agent, and evidence identity
